info.title: Halyard API
info.description:
All Halyard services in one place. Sign in with `POST /api/accounts/auth/login`, then use **Authorize** with the access token; it works for every service.

Demo users: `anna@nordwerk.example` / `demo1234` (customer), `ops@halyard.example` / `halyard-ops` (operations).

post.description: A new importer signs up. Creates the company and its first admin.
Signs in with email and password.

get.description: Returns the signed-in user and company, with a refreshed token.

patch.description: Updates the caller's company. Company admins only.

get.description: Returns one company the caller may see.

post.description: Adds a team member. Company admins only.
Public, indicative price for the website. Nothing is saved.
Prices a request and saves it as a bookable quote.

get.description: Lists the newest quotes the caller may see.

post.description: Customer accepts one option; ops then confirms it with the carrier.

get.description: Lists bookings the caller may see.

post.description: Ops confirms space with the carrier.

get.description: Lists rates, optionally filtered by lane and container type.

patch.description: Changes a rate's prices, transit time, validity or status.

get.description: Suggests vessel names for a carrier.

post.description: Quote request from the public website. No sign-in needed.

patch.description: Moves a lead through the sales pipeline.

post.description: Receives container events from the tracking data provider.
Demo helper: moves the shipment on as if every container reported.

get.description: Returns one shipment by id or reference.
Returns headline numbers for the dashboard.
Lists documents; ``status=open`` shows what waits on the caller.

post.description: Uploads a new version of a document.
Approves a document or sends it back with a note.

get.description: Lists invoices; customers only see issued and later ones.

post.description: Records payment of an issued invoice.

get.description: Gross profit per shipment and per TEU.

post.description: Marks every notification in the caller's feed as read.
